removed: I'm a big fan of Metabase. Write SQL - show chart.
Metabase is the most impressive piece of software I’ve used in a long time. If you have data you want to understand give it a try. It’s so easy to spin up
In terms of BI, there is no second best to Metabase.

just setup a metabase instance at my friends startup and now the ops team is using it left right and centre. The model feature is a game changer. h/t to Metabase for building the most delightful and well thought tool for non tech folks.
I’m forgetting how to write SQL queries 🤔 It’s all Metabase’s fault for having such an awesome query editor
Metabase is amazing. If you're a founder, especially non technical, get your engineers to install and set it up. It's transformational!
TIL about Metabase. Wow, the time we've wasted not using this is incalculable.
I love simple and efficient tools that are straightforward. I've been using Metabase and it is simply lovely

Metabase is really really awesome. I love the speed of implementation for new dashboards and reports. Totally awesome. Can't wait for new features. Might as well learn some clojure and contrib myself!
Metabase proves you can add power without taking away simplicity.

Searching for a relatively hassle-free reporting and dashboarding tool to hook up to your database? Can't recommend Metabase enough - lovely interface, and really great functionality out of a jar or Docker file. It's brilliant!
